# PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

Title: acktracker.max_retries
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `acktracker.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `20` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_retries = 20
```

Title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 1.1

option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling. - New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.

- New option `scheduler.log_level`: log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `quota.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4798 (SCHEDULER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `snapshotter.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E4663 (COORDINATOR_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `broker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

- New error code PQ-E3805 (DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2547 (COMPACTOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

Title: metrics.interval_s
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `metrics.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | metrics |
| Unit | s |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `metrics.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
interval_s = 10
```

Title: Postmortem INC-2024-171
Type: incident
Version: 4.x

# Postmortem INC-2024-171: search-indexer degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 90 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `search-indexer`

## Summary
During the incident, `search-indexer` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E1915 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `search-indexer` fired.
- T+22: On-call engineer found PQ-E1915 in the broker logs.
- T+45: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+90: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E1915.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# `spool.interval_s` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `60` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | s |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.interval_s` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
interval_s = 60
```

|---|---|

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.timeout_ms` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.

Title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 1.1

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

# PQ-E3557 REPLICATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The replicator refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `replicator.max_connections`.

# Postmortem INC-2025-198: shipping-tracker degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `shipping-tracker`

## Summary
During the incident, `shipping-tracker` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E3177 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `shipping-tracker` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E3177 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E3177.
- Add an alert for this error code.

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

# PQ-E4007 BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the broker use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Set `broker.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

The in-memory buffer of the quota is full and new data is rejected.

- A deployment where nodes have different settings

Reduce the incoming rate or increase `quota.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Title: coordinator.threshold_percent
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `coordinator.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `85` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | % |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.threshold_percent` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
threshold_percent = 85
```

# PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The coordinator is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.

# `scheduler.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
threshold_percent = 75
```

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Reduce the incoming rate or increase `scheduler.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# `dlq.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_retries = 8
```

# Postmortem INC-2024-147: search-indexer degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `search-indexer`

## Summary
During the incident, `search-indexer` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2051 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `search-indexer` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2051 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2051.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

Title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 1.1

option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling. - New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.

- New option `scheduler.log_level`: log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `quota.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4798 (SCHEDULER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `snapshotter.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E4663 (COORDINATOR_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `broker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

- New error code PQ-E3805 (DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2547 (COMPACTOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

Title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 1.1

option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling. - New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.

- New option `scheduler.log_level`: log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `quota.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4798 (SCHEDULER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `snapshotter.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E4663 (COORDINATOR_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `broker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

- New error code PQ-E3805 (DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2547 (COMPACTOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

# Postmortem INC-2024-166: fraud-scoring degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `fraud-scoring`

## Summary
During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4013 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `fraud-scoring` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E4013 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4013.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[scheduler]

# PQ-E3682 REPLICATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the replicator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `replicator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`

The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

# `partitioner.compression`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `none` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.compression` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
compression = "none"
```

Title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 1.1

option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling. - New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.

- New option `scheduler.log_level`: log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `quota.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4798 (SCHEDULER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `snapshotter.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

- New error code PQ-E4663 (COORDINATOR_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `broker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

- New error code PQ-E3805 (DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2547 (COMPACTOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

# PQ-E1779 INGRESS_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `ingress: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the ingress is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `ingress.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

- A deployment where nodes have different settings

Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

[acktracker]

```

# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

- A consumer that stopped reading

Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# Postmortem INC-2025-157: billing-events degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 55 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `billing-events`

## Summary
During the incident, `billing-events` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4708 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `billing-events` fired.
- T+13: On-call engineer found PQ-E4708 in the broker logs.
- T+27: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+55: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4708.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

# `acktracker.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
interval_s = 30
```
